title_zh: 询问租约终止与水电交接程序

scenario.label_zh: 询问租约终止与水电交接程序
scenario.goal_zh: 询问终止租约所需程序并约定索取程序和水电交接清单

context_zh: 虚构租赁服务沟通练习。此处仅请求书面流程，不陈述真实租赁法律或提供法律建议。
author: author-phase12-c

sentences.speaker: Kai
sentences.text: I'm the tenant in flat six, and I'd like to terminate the rental agreement at the end of June.

sentences.speaker: Nora
sentences.text: I can send you the written procedure. We haven't checked whether that date fits your agreement yet.

sentences.speaker: Kai
sentences.text: Please do. I don't want this conversation to be mistaken for a completed notice.

sentences.speaker: Nora
sentences.text: Understood. I'll also include a checklist for the final utility readings and account handover.

sentences.speaker: Kai
sentences.text: That will help. I'll check both documents before submitting anything.

sentences.speaker: Nora
sentences.text: All right. I'll send them to the contact address already on your rental record.
